name: Dalson's Tears Cauldron
objectiveText: Progress The Scourge's plague cauldron stands before you, spewing vast amounts of toxins into the air.  A small, non-descript access panel lies in the base of the cauldron's vast platform. Having already defeated the cauldron lord and acquired its key, you are free to add the appropriate reagents to the cauldron to make a counter agent to the plague. Arcane Quickener  ( 1 ) Somatic Intensifier  ( 5 ) Runecloth  ( 4 )

comments.body:
If you are looking for rep with the Agent Dawn, the cauldron quests are the best bet outside of the Undead instances (SC/UD Strath and Scholomance). 

Make sure you have your Vitrous Focuser in the bag, if you dont have one you can buy it from the AD Alchemist in Chillwind Camp. Also be sure to equip your AD Commendation trinket. (Save all the scourgestones for when you hit revered). 

If you are 60 the best place to go grind  is The Ruins of Andorhal, I can get about 50 Somatic Intensifiers and 3 stacks of Runecloth in an hour worth of grinding as a Rogue, if you are a caster it may be a bit less due to downtime. For a lower level your best bet is going to Dalson's Tears itself. (Always remember that the trick of grinding is killing mobs that you can finish off in 20 seconds or less and that respawn fast). 

When you have a good amount of Runecloth and Somatic Intensifiers head to Chillwind Camp and buy some Arcane Quickeners from the AD Alchemist (Those are expensive and if you dont use them fast they will despawn from your bags, so only buy what you need). Return to Dalson's Tears and use the cauldron to deliver the quest. 

Then Rinse and repeat. Each turn in will give you about 25 rep for non-humans and about 28 rep for humans.

you will get 40 silver off the mobs trying to get 4 somatic instensifyers to drop

Don't know if things have changed since the last post in 2006 but seriously this repeat quest is an appalling way to grind Argent Dawn rep now.  The [item=13370] is free but it costs you 45s for the [item=13320] from [npc=11056] at Chillwind Camp and you'll need one for each and every turn in at the cauldrons.  The parts from the undead mobs are easy enough to get but I was Friendly with Argent Dawn when I tried the repeatable version of this quest and got 15 rep.

As you can get 5 rep from each undead kill then getting 15 from the cauldrons is pathetic, plus it will cost you 45s to buy the [item=13320] for each 15 rep.

The arcane quickener costs 40silver!
So don't plan to use this quest as a power leveling scheme!
replies: umm... 40 silver isn't a lot of money... especially considering you can sell a stack of wool for 1 gold.
